topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I heard the news about you moving, and I can't help but think about all the times we've spent together. It's true, change is a part of life, and I remind myself of that. I'm grateful for the memories we've made, from laughing over inside jokes to supporting each other through tough times. While the miles will stretch between us, I know our bond won't weaken. There's comfort in the thought of catching up on long calls, and maybe even planning visits. I'll miss you, but I'm looking forward to seeing how this new chapter unfolds for you.
